subject: general
question:
Select the correct direct form of the given sentence.

He inquired whether the boy's name was Ahmed.

options.text: He asked, “The boy's name is Ahmed?”
He asked, “Whether the boy's name was Ahmed?”
He asked, “Was the boy's name Ahmed?”
He asked, “Is the boy's name Ahmed?”

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** He inquired whether the boy's name was Ahmed.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"whether" indicates a Yes/No question**
 
 
• The conjunction "whether" is removed, and the direct speech must start with an auxiliary verb to form an interrogative sentence.
